caption: The drawing depicts a single, large pottery vessel positioned centrally on a plain background. The vessel is cylindrical with a slightly wider opening at the top and a gently rounded body that tapers towards a narrower base. The rim of the vessel is thick and slightly protruding. There are two symmetrical handles, one on each side, positioned just below the rim, each with a subtle, curved design. The color of the vessel is predominantly a warm, rusty orange-brown with variations in shading to suggest the reflective, glazed surface and areas of natural wear. Some lighter areas on the body illustrate reflections or surface irregularities, and there are small patches of white near the base and below the rim that indicate aged or weathered spots. The vessel is centered within a double-lined border on an off-white sheet, and no other objects are present in the composition.
title: Preserving Jar
